hints: A playlist window must contain no repeated song.
Move the left edge forward until the new song is unique in the current window.
Update the longest window after each right edge.
analogy: Keep a sliding shelf of songs with no duplicate; when one repeats, discard from the left until unique again.
example: For 1,2,1,3, the longest unique interval is 1,2 or 2,1,3; answer 3.
algorithm: Use two pointers and a last-seen position map. For each right index, set left=max(left,last[song]+1), then update last and the maximum length.
correctness: The maintained window is the longest duplicate-free interval ending at the current position; taking its maximum considers every valid playlist segment.
complexity: O(n) expected time with a hash map and O(n) space.
